'''2012 Bespin Regionals Mike (2012 Bespin Regionals) DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Mike (2012 Bespin Regionals)|Mike]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
